variant.title: Variant
variant.description: Header layout variant. 'nt-gov-au' shows the NT.GOV.AU desert-rose logo only. 'agency-internet' shows the NT Government mono logo plus an agency title. 'other-site' is the same as agency-internet with distinct styling.

agencyName.title: Agency name
agencyName.description: Agency or site name shown as the title link in 'agency-internet' and 'other-site' variants.

agencyHref.title: Agency URL
agencyHref.description: URL the agency/site title links to.

logoAlt.title: Logo alt text
logoAlt.description: Alt text for the logo image.

navItems.title: Navigation items
navItems.description: Top-level navigation items shown in the header.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Optional Font Awesome icon class (e.g. 'fa-light fa-home').

showSearch.title: Show search
showSearch.description: Whether to include a search bar.

searchVariant.title: Search variant
searchVariant.description: 'expanded' shows the full search bar; 'icon' shows a search icon that expands on click.

searchAction.title: Search form action
searchAction.description: URL the search form GETs to. The search input uses the field name 'query'.

name: header
description: Site-wide header with NT Government branding, navigation, and optional search.
